description_en: Set the Protection Action for Specified HTTP DDoS Attack Rules
description_zh: 设置HTTP DDoS攻击防护指定规则防护动作
name: SetHttpDDoSAttackRuleAction

parameters.description_en: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API.
parameters.description_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html API
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en:
List of rule IDs to be operated on, separated by English commas (,).
> You can call the [DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~) API to get this parameter.
parameters.description_zh:
需要操作的规则ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以调用[DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~)接口获取该参数。
parameters.help_en:
List of rule IDs to be operated on, separated by English commas (,).
> You can call the [DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~) API to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要操作的规则ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以调用[DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: rule_ids

parameters.description_en:
Rule action, with values:

- **deny**: Block.

- **js**: JS Verification.

- **observe**: Observe.
parameters.description_zh:
规则动作，取值：

- **deny**：拦截。

- **js**：JS验证。

- **observe**：观察。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_zh:
